services.name: Inshore Fishing Trips
services.desc: Enjoy a memorable day aboard the "AFISHINADO", a Virginia Beach and Chesapeake Bay charter! Duration 4, 6, or 8 Hour Options About There is trolling the Virginia Beach oceanfront for Blues, Spanish Mackerel, King Mackerel, and other seasonal fish, Drifting for Flounder, Red Drum, Croakers, Black Sea Bass and more. Then there is anchoring and chumming for Cobia which can get up to 100lbs here in Virginia Beach, Big Red Drum that put up a great fight for any angler, and SHARK! We have a lot of different Sharks that swim in the coastal waters surrounding Virginia Beach and the Chesapeake Bay during the Summer months. Some of them are The Hammerheads, Bulls, Tiger Shark, Sand Tiger, Black tips

services.name: Near Shore Fishing Trips
services.desc: These are great trips to fill up your cooler after a long day on the water! Duration 6 or 8 Hour Options About A Near shore adventure consists of a few more options like either fishing the Chesapeake Bay from the Bay Bridge Tunnel to the mouth of the Chesapeake Bay for species like Striped Bass (Rockfish), Flounder, Croaker, Spot, Red Drum, Cobia, Sheepshead, Spadefish and Shark. Another charter destination we head to is the Chesapeake Light Tower (14 miles from Rudee Inlet), where we fish for Black Sea Bass, Tautog, Sheepshead, Cobia, Flounder and Spadefish. Spadefish is a great fight pound for pound on light tackle. Another option available is to stop at some of the near shore wrecks
